about_the_game:
For all of my games I work non stop to expand and support them post-release. For the Falconeer this has come down to several free content updates and most recently a full Remaster.  This Revolution Remaster was released free for all existing Steam users and integrated the previous "Edge of the World" DLC to bring the best and most complete version to gamers.   

This remaster represents over a year of development and a full overhaul of the game, mechanics, visuals and missions. Bulwark : Falconeer Chroncicles , the other game so far in this franchise is also getting regular free content updates.  And starting 2026 I will be working on a third game in this franchise called "Ancient Waves", this will be a ship design /open world sailing adventure, telling the story of this world preceding the Falconeer.

This 'Supporter DLC' contains a Mongres styled armor set for your Warbird, purchasable at Dunkle and Neverin.  But its main goal is to support future development of Falconeer Chronicles games and updates. It is a supporter DLC and it helps me to keep working on this universe and produce more games and content and to keep improving and supporting the existing games.

Cheerio,
Tomas Sala --- the solodev behind this franchise.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Proton
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Arc A380. or Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD RX 6400
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Only GAME CONTROLLERS are supported, no VR controllers. Most VR displays supported
  • VR Support: Microsoft Xbox Controller for Windows® (or equivalent) is recommended.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Proton
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent AMD
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX3080 or AMD RX 7800 XT
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Only GAME CONTROLLERS are supported, no VR controllers. Most VR displays supported
  • VR Support: Microsoft Xbox Controller for Windows® (or equivalent) is recommended.
